newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury Finance cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury Finance cut.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffray said it downgraded Mercury Finance Co to market performer from buy and placed its earnings estimates and price target under review.
-- on Wednesday, Mercury Finance said accounting irregularities caused the company to overstate earnings by $90 million over four years and its chief financial officer James Doyle had disappeared.
-- the company said it will restate its net income for 1993, 1994, 1995 and 1996.
-- Piper Jaffray said the "tax effected" restatement is preliminary since the departure of the CFO is making it difficult to assess the extent of unauthorized transactions.
-- Piper Jaffray said on pre-tax basis, the preliminary restatement is about $145 million.
-- Piper Jaffray said "our guess is much of the over- recognized income came from the insurance subsidiary."
-- additional details were not immediately available.
-- Mercury Finance had not yet opened for trading.
